title: b7z9.25.e: missed-superframe SYNCED->DESYNCED transition + drift gate (R-02a-081) Python side
description: Child of b7z9.25 (spec 02a-coordinated-capacity.md:267 transition table, R-02a-081): python/src/lichen/timing/sfn.py:148-157 on_missed_superframe EARLY-RETURNS unless RECOVERING, so the SYNCED -> DESYNCED transition on >=3 missed beacons (transition table :267: 'SYNCED | >=3 missed beacons | DESYNCED | Suppress TX, reset counters'; BEACON_TIMEOUT_SUPERFRAMES = 3) is unimplemented. Deliverable: track missed superframes in SYNCED too (increment per on_missed_superframe, transition to DESYNCED at >= 3 with counter resets, valid beacon resets the count), mirror in the drift gate thread if trivially adjacent (drift_ppm > GUARD_PPM transition is ALSO absent per the parent bead), add unit tests to python/tests/timing/test_sfn.py. NOTE the R-02a-082 GUARD_PPM 250-vs-5000 conflict is an adjudication bead (separate).
close_reason: DONE: Python DesyncFSM now implements the R-02a-081 SYNCED -> DESYNCED transition on >= 3 consecutive missed superframes (spec/02a-coordinated-capacity.md:267 transition table) - previously on_missed_superframe early-returned unless RECOVERING, so a SYNCED node never desynced regardless of root silence. Also added the SYNCED valid-beacon streak reset in on_beacon (an isolated miss cannot accumulate toward desync) and the drift gate was already present (:133-146). Tests (python/tests/timing/test_sfn.py): test_synced_desyncs_after_three_missed_superframes (counts 1,2 stay SYNCED; third -> DESYNCED with counter resets) and test_synced_valid_beacon_resets_missed_counter (a valid beacon clears the streak). Suite: test_sfn.py 91/91; desync/sfn/ccp subset 575 passed; ruff clean. Reviewer (kimi-k3) pass 1: PASS on the Python change with cross-language follow-ups filed as project-LICHEN-worker6-pxxl (Rust desync.rs + C tdma.c same-row implementation + a ccp16-desync.json vector case for the row - Rust desync.rs has no missed-superframe tracking and C tdma.c:148-162 is still no-op outside RECOVERING).
